name: Seokguram Grotto and Bulguksa Temple
description: On Mount Toham near Gyeongju, South Korea, Seokguram is a stone-built grotto from the 8th century, set about 750 metres above sea level. Inside its domed chamber a large seated Buddha gazes out toward the East Sea, ringed by finely carved guardians and disciples. Bulguksa, the temple complex a few kilometres downhill, completes the pair, and visitors often come for sunrise.
